text:
Type: rectangular mirror with dark wood frame
Use: checking your look, adding light and depth; bathroom, hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: solid wood frame stained dark brown, glass mirror
Colors: dark brown, silver mirror
Shape: horizontal rectangle in a thin box-like frame with square edges, plain flat profile, simple and light visual weight
Feel: calm, warm, tidy
Goes with: dark wood, white walls, white tiles, black or brass accents; Scandinavian or minimalist bathrooms and hallways
